focus: جلسه پنجم · مالکیت با have/has got

sentences.en: I am at your service, what can I do for you?

sentences.fa: مي شه پنجره رو باز کني؟
در رو قفل کنم؟ مي خوام لباس هام رو عوض کنم.
sentences.en: Shall I lock the door? I would like to change my clothes.

sentences.fa: شام رو بکشم؟ مي خوام ميز رو بچينم.
sentences.en: Shall I serve the dinner? I would like to set the table.

sentences.fa: آشپزي بلد نيستم، شام رو بيرون بخوريم؟
sentences.en: I can't cook, shall we eat dinner out?

sentences.fa: شطرنج بلد نيستم، تخته نرد بازي کنيم؟
sentences.en: I can't play chess, shall we play backgammon?

sentences.fa: جای پارک توو خيابون هست، مي شه اينجا پارک نکني؟
sentences.en: There are some car parks in the street, could you not park here?
How many languages can you speak?

sentences.fa: برادرت کدوم زبانها رو بلده صحبت کنه؟
sentences.en: Which languages can your brother speak?

sentences.fa: امر ديگه اي با من نداري؟ شام رو بکشم؟
sentences.en: Anything else with me? Shall I serve the dinner?
Where shall I put my recorder?
Shall I put my recorder on the table?
Here's the menu, what shall we order?

sentences.fa: امر ديگه اي با من نداري؟

sentences.en: Would you like to take a taxi?
